stages.title: Freeze guard
actions: Treat Vertical AI V1 / master snapshot v2 as immutable references.
Reject any V2 work that mutates V1 fingerprints or PC/CIL baselines.

stages.title: Parallel V2 surfaces
actions: Introduce V2 datasets/APIs alongside V1 without replacing V1 paths.
Bind V2 design to certified V1 fingerprints for continuity evidence.

stages.title: Module swap equivalence
actions: Prove replaceable modules dual-run equivalent on certified fixtures.
Promote modules only after contract + reproducibility PASS.

stages.title: Operation profile rollout
actions: Adopt repository operation profiles in planning-only mode first.
Require human approval + execute_authorized before any enactment.

stages.title: Consumer session enablement
actions: Enable CIL-mediated collaboration sessions using certified connectors.
Keep connector master snapshots immutable during enablement.

stages.title: V2 certification
actions: Freeze Vertical AI V2 master snapshot only after production operation readiness.
